# Product-Manager-Skills — Dean Peters

Twelve skills from [deanpeters/Product-Manager-Skills](https://github.com/deanpeters/Product-Manager-Skills),
by **Dean Peters** (Productside). Vendored at upstream `a03af68`, synced 2026-08-18.

Upstream carries 77 skills; these twelve are the subset I pulled. Grab the rest from source if you need them.

## License

**CC BY-NC-SA 4.0** — see [`LICENSE`](./LICENSE) in this folder. Three things that follow from that:

- **Attribution** — credit Dean Peters and link the source. Done here and in each skill's README.
- **NonCommercial** — the license does not permit commercial use. Read it yourself before using these in a work setting; that constraint is on how you *use* them, not on this repository hosting them.
- **ShareAlike** — adaptations must carry the same license. These are vendored unmodified, so nothing here is an adaptation.

this folder is Dean Peters' work, byte-for-byte as published.

## The skills

| Skill | What it does | Time |
|---|---|---|
| [ai-shaped-readiness-advisor](./ai-shaped-readiness-advisor) | Assess whether your product work is AI-first or AI-shaped. Use when evaluating AI maturity and choosing the next team capability to build. | 15-20 min |
| [company-research](./company-research) | Create a company research brief with executive quotes, product strategy, and org context. Use when preparing for interviews, competitive analysis, partnerships, or market-entry work. | 20-40 min |
| [context-engineering-advisor](./context-engineering-advisor) | Diagnose context stuffing vs. context engineering. Use when an AI workflow feels bloated, brittle, or hard to steer reliably. | 15-20 min |
| [discovery-process](./discovery-process) | Run a full discovery cycle from problem hypothesis to validated solution. Use when a team needs a structured path through framing, interviews, synthesis, and experiments. | 30-60 min |
| [jobs-to-be-done](./jobs-to-be-done) | Uncover customer jobs, pains, and gains in a structured JTBD format. Use when clarifying unmet needs, repositioning a product, or improving discovery and messaging. | 20-30 min |
| [pol-probe](./pol-probe) | Define a Proof of Life probe to test a risky hypothesis cheaply. Use when you need harsh truth before building real product. | 15-25 min |
| [pol-probe-advisor](./pol-probe-advisor) | Select the right Proof of Life (PoL) probe based on hypothesis, risk, and resources. Use this to match the validation method to the real learning goal, not tooling comfort. | 15-20 min |
| [prioritization-advisor](./prioritization-advisor) | Choose a prioritization framework based on stage, team context, and stakeholder needs. Use when deciding between RICE, ICE, value/effort, or another scoring approach. | 15-25 min |
| [product-strategy-session](./product-strategy-session) | Run an end-to-end product strategy session across positioning, discovery, and roadmap planning. Use when a team needs validated direction before committing to execution. | 2-4 weeks |
| [recommendation-canvas](./recommendation-canvas) | Evaluate an AI product idea across outcomes, hypotheses, risks, and positioning. Use when deciding whether an AI solution deserves investment or recommendation. | 30-45 min |
| [roadmap-planning](./roadmap-planning) | Plan a strategic roadmap across prioritization, epic definition, stakeholder alignment, and sequencing. Use when turning strategy into a release plan that teams can execute. | 45-90 min |
| [user-story](./user-story) | Create user stories with Mike Cohn format and Gherkin acceptance criteria. Use when turning user needs into development-ready work with clear outcomes and testable conditions. | 5-10 min |

## Using them

Each skill is a folder. Copy the whole directory into your `skills/` directory or add it as a Skill in
Claude — `SKILL.md` is what Claude loads; the `template.md` and `sample-*.md` files are references the
skill points at.

## Staying current

This is a pinned snapshot, not a live mirror. Re-syncing means a fresh vendor commit against a newer
upstream SHA, so the diff stays readable.
